content: An SVM with an RBF kernel (scikit-learn's SVC, 1 thread). C is the strength of the penalty on errors, gamma the inverse of the kernel's width. Shows the accuracy, the time, a breakdown of the mistakes and the number of support vectors per digit, and passes predictions for every test image to compare.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Accuracy, CPU time, settings, and predictions for every test image
